verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerting docs say any signal can be evaluated against a threshold or for abnormal behavior. NRQL-based alerts are its primary alert type, and notifications can route issues to the correct system or team. The pack contains no evidence of notification grouping/correlation or silencing/muting, which are two of the story's four named elements. Missing for 10: documented notification grouping, documented silencing/muting of notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: Configure any signal to be evaluated against a threshold, or if it exhibits abnormal behavior.
Route issues to the correct system or team using notifications.
You define the data to watch, the thresholds that if exceeded mean an issue, who is notified, and how.
Set up NRQL-based alerts (our primary and most powerful type of alert)
